description: This is a Java interface file defining the 'CustomerService' interface, which declares methods for managing Customer entities, including retrieval, listing, and address lookup functionalities within a sales management application.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the given first name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with the specified store.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their nickname.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer or updates an existing one, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers based on store and criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname and store ID.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's address derived from IP geolocation, may throw ServiceException.
